_comment: Copy to portal_redact.config.json (gitignored) and fill in the values from
YOUR deployment before capturing workshop screenshots.
These are the strings the capture pipeline rewrites in the portal DOM before
taking a screenshot, and the strings the OCR sweep then looks for in the
committed PNGs. They are real tenant identifiers, which is exactly why they
do not belong in a published repo - keep them in the gitignored copy.
'literals' are ordered pairs: [findThis, replaceWithThis]. Order matters,
because replacements are applied in sequence.
